description: Add support for custom schema names in DTOs to improve OpenAPI documentation and SDK generation. Currently, DTOs generate repetitive, auto-generated class names in OpenAPI schemas, which creates confusion when generating client SDKs. This feature will allow developers to specify custom schema names for their DTOs, making the generated OpenAPI documentation cleaner and more maintainable.
functional_requirements: Add a __schema_name__ attribute to the AbstractDTO base class that can be optionally set by developers
When __schema_name__ is provided, use it as the model class name in generated OpenAPI schemas instead of auto-generated names
Ensure the schema name customization works consistently across all DTO implementations (StructDTO, PydanticDTO, etc.)
Update the OpenAPI schema generation logic to respect custom DTO schema names when creating model definitions
Maintain backward compatibility by defaulting to current auto-generated names when __schema_name__ is not specified
Document the new __schema_name__ feature in the DTO documentation with usage examples
